name: Voss
quote: The Division betrayed every one of us.
identity: The veteran at the front of the crew. Black aviators, red scarf, shearling collar; a charcoal-and-red fighter with four engine plumes.
purpose: Break comfortable firing positions. Voss turns the whole screen into a flight lane and makes the player move before committing to damage.
flight: Cruises with a banking sway, locks a rush direction, makes fast lateral turbo passes, then returns. His separate charged rush exits the playfield and re-enters from the north.

attacks.name: Turbo pursuit
attacks.tell: A committed flight lane and charge cue precede the rush. Each lateral row gets another warning.
attacks.action: The initial rush leads into repeated side-to-side passes. The native turbo return brings him back to his lane.
attacks.response: Leave the warned row before he commits. Use roll or somersault if his body closes the gap.

attacks.name: Charged fly-through
attacks.tell: 1.65 seconds of charge. His nose turns toward the aim point before he launches.
attacks.action: He accelerates into a straight rush, exits, waits briefly, then flies back in from the top and recovers.
attacks.response: Make a late lateral move after his aim settles. Keep his return lane clear.

attacks.name: Aimed energy shot
attacks.tell: A short committed gun tell points at the target’s earlier position.
attacks.action: The shared gun owner releases a slower, destructible energy charge rather than an ordinary tracer.
attacks.response: Move out of the aim line or destroy the energy object.

name: Nyx
quote: Your cloak belongs to us now.
identity: Black-and-violet swept hair, shaved side and a high collar. Her silver/violet craft has two prominent cylindrical engines.
purpose: Make target acquisition matter. Find her with Retina or a missile, then use the visible retaliation window to attack.
flight: Begins in a spectre cloak with a slow banking drift. Regular Retina, Multi-Retina or a missile reveals her; after retaliation and recovery she cloaks again.

attacks.name: Spectre cloak & reveal
attacks.tell: The hull fades into its spectre treatment, but remains available to the dedicated Retina target path.
attacks.action: A successful lock or missile hit calls her reveal handler. She becomes visible and prepares shadow retaliation.
attacks.response: Use Retina/Multi-Retina to expose her. A missile works with or without a prior lock.

attacks.name: Shadow-charge retaliation
attacks.tell: Aimed warning lanes and an energy charge precede each pulse. Initial Furious windup is 1.15 seconds.
attacks.action: On Furious she makes three charged pulses. The current shared round gate emits one destructible energy charge per pulse.
attacks.response: Keep moving between pulses or destroy the energy charges. Attack while the revealed hull is readable.

name: Rook
quote: Big guns scare ya when you are not the only one who has them?
identity: Bald, scarred, heavily built, full dark beard and orange armor. His broad gunmetal/orange ship carries paired long guns.
purpose: Punish hovering in a lock. Rook plants the heavy ship, commits to a firing direction and forces the player to break that line.
flight: Heavy cruising sway with evasive rolls. During his current special, he holds position, rotates toward the aim point, fires from alternating gun sockets, then recovers.

attacks.name: Locked dual chaingun
attacks.tell: 1.65-second charge with accelerating lock beeps and a lane warning. Aim follows for the first 72% of the tell.
attacks.action: He alternates the two gun sockets every 0.09 seconds. Furious releases 30 slugs. If the target is still inside the lock when it completes, early rounds gain limited tracking.
attacks.response: Break the lock with a late sidestep. Keep moving across the firing line instead of trying to destroy the slugs.
facts: Ordinary bullets cannot be shot down

attacks.name: Hook / ram selections — current result
attacks.tell: These names still occur in his selection book.
attacks.action: The latest role override converts both selections into the same chaingun special. They do not currently execute as separate hook or ram attacks.
attacks.response: Treat the live result as the chaingun pattern above. Restoring distinct attacks is an open design decision.

name: Kaia
quote: I will not miss a second time.
identity: Short blond hair and teal flight gear. Her slender teal-and-ivory craft uses a crescent-like wing silhouette.
purpose: Fill a committed corridor with slower, readable pressure. She controls space through a sequence of energy rollers rather than a single instantaneous fan.
flight: A light banking drift between bursts, with evasive rolls under nearby fire. She holds the attack lane through her charge and rapid release.

attacks.name: Teal roller gatling
attacks.tell: 1.35-second charge with a broad lane warning and growing muzzle energy.
attacks.action: Furious releases 16 rollers at 0.12-second intervals, alternating small aim offsets. Rollers travel at 225 px/s, have 3 HP each and can ricochet from side boundaries.
attacks.response: Move out of the corridor before the stream arrives, or open a path by destroying rollers. Watch for side-wall rebounds.

attacks.name: Difficulty steps
attacks.tell: The warning still precedes each burst.
attacks.action: Easy / Normal / Hard / Furious use 8 / 12 / 14 / 16 rollers, travelling at 175 / 195 / 210 / 225 px/s.
attacks.response: Use lower difficulties to learn the burst lane; higher difficulty adds density and travel speed.
facts: Current pattern is a burst, not a five-way fan

name: Jace
quote: We are not going home empty-handed.
identity: Messy brown hair, stubble and a red high collar. His red/ivory fighter has sharp reverse-swept wings and paired engines.
purpose: Mix an agile release with a second threat: destroy his stolen Helix charge for a counterburst, or give it room while avoiding his follow-up dash.
flight: Sways while charging, advances through a short swerve, releases the Helix ball, then recovers. His secondary selection is a straight charge dash.

attacks.name: Swerve Helix
attacks.tell: The ball grows at his nose while a wide warning marks the aim. Furious initial charge is 1.15 seconds.
attacks.action: He swerves forward and releases roughly 0.62 seconds into that movement. The Helix travels at 155 px/s and carries 6 HP.
attacks.response: Destroy it early: the native counterburst deals 22 damage to Rough Riders within 210 pixels. Otherwise move away from its path and close burst.

attacks.name: Charge dash
attacks.tell: A dedicated lane warning precedes the committed line.
attacks.action: His secondary attack uses the native ram controller, rushing through the target lane before returning to cruising position.
attacks.response: Step out of the line after commitment, or evade through the dangerous pass.

attacks.name: Aimed energy shot
attacks.tell: A short gun tell precedes the shot.
attacks.action: Between specials he can release the shared destructible energy charge.
attacks.response: Strafe or shoot the energy object.
